onboarding_vault_dir_desc: On Android, app data is deleted when the app is uninstalled. Choose an external directory to keep your data safe even after uninstalling.
onboarding_vault_dir_local_desc: Data is stored inside the app and will be deleted when uninstalled (default).
onboarding_vault_dir_saf_desc: Data is stored in a user-selected external directory and persists after uninstall. Recommended.
onboarding_vault_dir_restart_desc: The vault directory has changed. Please restart the app to use the new directory.

onboarding_create_object_desc: Create objects from Identity, Travel, Financial, or Professional pages, and use templates to organize your data.
onboarding_templates_desc: System templates include ID card, passport, bank account, and more. You can also customize templates in Template Manager.
onboarding_security_desc: Set up your master password, biometrics, and auto-lock to keep your vault secure.

drag_guide_step1_desc: In the workspace list, drag and drop files directly onto any object card to attach them. The card will highlight when hovered during a drag.
drag_guide_step2_desc: Click an object card to open the detail panel. Drag files into the panel area to attach them to the current object.
drag_guide_step3_desc: In the attachment manager dialog, drag files directly into the window to batch upload multiple attachments at once.
guide_card_step1_desc: Each object card shows a template icon, object name, and category label at the top. If the object is linked to a template, the template name is also shown. Action buttons on the right: History (clock), Attachments (paperclip), Edit (pencil), Delete (trash). The card body displays field properties as labeled chips.
guide_card_step2_desc: Field border colors indicate sensitivity levels: 🟢 Green = Public, 🔵 Blue = Internal, 🟠 Amber = Sensitive, 🔴 Red = Critical. Non-public field values are automatically blurred to protect privacy.
guide_card_step3_desc: Click anywhere on the card to open the detail panel. Use the top-right buttons to: view version history, manage attachments, edit the object, or delete it. Drag and drop files onto the card to quickly add attachments.
guide_tpl_step1_desc: A template defines the data structure of an object, with a set of fields. Each field has a name, type (text, number, date, select, etc.), and sensitivity level. When creating an object using a template, the matching fields are generated automatically.
guide_tpl_step2_desc: Go to Settings > Template Manager to view all available templates, create new ones, or edit field structures. You can choose icons, assign pages, reorder fields, and set sensitivity levels. Deprecated fields can be restored or permanently cleaned up.
guide_tpl_step3_desc: When creating a new object, select a template to quickly populate data. You can change or replace the template later. If a template is deleted, existing object data is preserved — the template name is shown with strikethrough.
guide_help_getting_started_desc: Learn the basics of SoloSoul and workspace navigation
guide_help_attachments_desc: Upload, download, rename, and manage attachments in trash
guide_help_sensitivity_desc: Understand different sensitivity levels and security policies
guide_help_objects_desc: Create, edit, history rollback, and trash management for objects
guide_help_templates_desc: Create, edit, field management, and deprecation of templates
guide_help_create_object_desc: Use templates to create objects with pre-defined structures
guide_detail_step1_desc: Drag files from your file manager directly into this detail panel to attach them. The panel will highlight when dragged over.
guide_detail_step2_desc: Click the Attachments button to open the manager, or drag files directly into the manager window for batch upload.
home_guide_step1_desc: Profile sections include Identity, Travel, Financial, and Professional predefined pages, plus any custom pages you create. Click a card to open its workspace.
home_guide_step2_desc: Quick access cards provide shortcuts to Settings, Trash, Plugins, OCR, Search, AI Chat, and Help. Click a card to jump to that feature.
home_guide_step3_desc: Long-press a custom page card in the Profile Sections area to edit its icon, name, and description. Predefined pages and quick access cards cannot be edited.
recovery_host_desc: Show this QR code or enter the address and PIN on your new device. Keep the app open until the transfer finishes.
recovery_host_localhost_warning: Could not detect your local network address. Please find this device's local IP manually and use it instead of 127.0.0.1.
recovery_receive_desc: Enter the address and PIN shown on your old device, then set a new master password for this device.
onboarding_recover_from_device_desc: Restore your account from a phone or computer running SoloSoul.
